text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, Marvelous Sunday and the others were offering up a rather suspicious prayer...

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Marvelous~~... Marvelouuus.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Beep-boop-beep-boop... Come in.
This is the Earth vessel, please respond...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Dragging itself, crawling out from the netherworld, crossing the river.
Let us illuminate the dark gloom and reveal its name.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: All right... now's the time!

text_block_list.name: The Three
text_block_list.text:
Marvelous☆
"REEN"...
...Who are you?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Uh-oh, and here I thought
that last one was gonna work~!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer! It's "Marvelous☆Telepathy,"
where we try to guess the same word!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...It was Miss Marvelous's idea.
She's invited me several times, saying, "Let's connect our different colors"...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
It won't lead to "Inflation"...
It's a distant "voyage route."
choice_data_list: That looks like a tough challenge...
That looks like a tough challenge...

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Even so, I want to make it a success!
Even if we're all over the place right now――

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Everyone wants to connect, right?☆
If that comes true, it'll be simply marvelous★☆★

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
However, the "flux density" continues to degenerate...
It cannot surpass "DAZT"...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
We... did not possess the same thing.
It seems we have no choice but to accept that...

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Everyone...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While there is a desire to connect,
their distinct sensibilities... seem to be
acting as a barrier to communication.
choice_data_list: Maybe the words themselves are becoming a barrier.
Maybe the words themselves are becoming a wall.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
I see... You're right.
Everyone's got their own kind of Marvelous!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Let's dance, just as our hearts desire!
Without overthinking anything!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: In other words, it seems she decided to dance as an alternative approach to using words.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"CUTT"... But...
If the possibilities of the "unknown" are "Hubble."
..."Rendezvous."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (THUD! tap-tap-tap)

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
—...It's dangerous to run around like that.
What if you bump into someone who can't see...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...You want to try it? ...I see.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
...Neo Universe and the others are "parallel."
...Yet "they do not repel"... right...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"...Our worlds lie on opposite sides of the divide.
Even if they never intersect... heheh."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
All three are dancing completely out of sync.
And yet—
choice_data_list: (She looks like she's having so much fun...!)
(She looks like she's having so much fun...!)

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
I feel it! It's getting closer!!
Mmmmmmm... Marvelous☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Ahahahaha!
We're totally out of sync right to the endーー☆

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"...But...
'Alphard' was 'felt far away', you know."

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"...It is strange, isn't it...?
Even though our cycles of reincarnation don't truly overlap... Fufu."

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Even if our Marvelous is different... our hearts can still connect!
We just took that very first step!
And that is, that is just so—

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Alright! Let's connect even more from here!
Dance more, and get waaaay more Marvelous☆★
choice_data_list: If there's anything I can do to help, just let me know!
Why not try picking up the pace of your dance?
Why don't we try picking up the dance pace?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Alright! Let's connect even more from here!
Dance more, and get waaaay more Marvelous☆★
choice_data_list: If there's anything I can do to help, just let me know!
Why not try picking up the pace of your dance?
Why don't we try picking up the dance pace?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Then you connect too, Trainer!
Marvelous is for everyone, after all☆

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"We're starting to get in sync a bit, aren't we?
Look, Trainer, around you, the orbs are..."

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha!
Let's make everyone's marvelous shine brighter and brighter!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The three of them dancing happily looked truly connected through that alone!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Oooooh! You're accelerating the Marvelous!
That'll bring us closer to success!

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Unlocking "Boosters."
Preparing for 『Ejection』...

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Wooww, so sharp and marvelous☆
I won't let myself lose either~~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Watching the three of them clash through dance,
it felt as though they were already connected as one!
